intro: A plate of nasi arab mandy ayam has about 850 kcal. Most of the calories come from the big, oily portion of mandy rice and the chicken with skin.
diet: Yes, it's actually high in protein from the chicken. But rice portions at Arab restaurants are usually very big. If you control the rice, this is one of the eating-out meals that can fit into a weight loss plan. Sharing with friends is also a smart move.
tips: Eat half the rice and tapau the rest for another meal.
Remove the chicken skin. The meat is still tender and tasty.
Take more salad and tomato sauce, and less raisins and nuts.

swap.name: Mandy chicken + half rice + salad
swap.why: You keep all the chicken protein, but cut the rice carbs and oil by half.

faq.q: What's the difference between nasi mandy and nasi kabsah?
faq.a: Mandy is usually slow-cooked with the chicken hung above the rice so the fat drips into it. Kabsah is cooked with spices and tomato in one pot.

faq.q: Why is mandy rice yellow and white?
faq.a: Some of the rice is coloured with turmeric or saffron for looks and aroma. The taste is almost the same.

faq.q: Is the mandy tomato sauce spicy?
faq.a: Usually it has a bit of chilli and is very light. It's great for adding flavour without many calories.
